description: This stacked bar chart compares the composition of generated responses across two categories, “Ours” and “Standard,” with each bar segmented into three colored parts representing “Generated Response” (orange), “Other” (green), and an unlabeled blue segment. The horizontal axis displays the two main categories, “Ours” and “Standard,” positioned vertically with “Ours” above “Standard.” The vertical axis represents the percentage composition, scaled linearly from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 20% intervals. For the “Ours” bar, the top orange segment is labeled 60.6%, the bottom green segment is labeled 31.7%, and the blue segment in between is unlabeled. For the “Standard” bar, the top orange segment is labeled 51.1%, the bottom green segment is labeled 25.3%, and the blue segment is labeled 23.6%. The bars are stacked vertically within each category, with the orange segment representing “Generated Response,” the green segment representing “Other,” and the blue segment representing an unspecified component. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific bar or segment.
